chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Hammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Al-Mukhtar, from Muhammad ibn Abdullah, who said:
I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), 'Can I recite the Quran in one night?' He (peace be upon him) said, 'I do not like it if you were to recite it in less than a month.'
ai.seo_question: How long should it take to recite the entire Quran according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam Al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) advises against rushing the Quranic recitation, preferring a duration of at least one month to ensure proper contemplation (tadabbur) and spiritual absorption. This recommendation aligns with the traditional practice of completing the Quran during the month of Ramadan, reflecting the Shia scholarly emphasis on quality and depth over mere speed in worship.
